stories.title: France : Les infirmiers libéraux face à la hausse du prix des carburants

en.title: France: Independent nurses facing rising fuel prices
en.summary: France's government is addressing fuel price increases and supply issues as diesel reached record highs of 2.41 euros per liter, impacting purchasing power during the presidential campaign period.

stories.title: Donald Trump va rencontrer Emmanuel Macron à New York lundi soir en marge de l'Assemblée générale des Nations Unies

en.title: Donald Trump to meet Emmanuel Macron in New York Monday evening during UN General Assembly
en.summary: The U.S. president and French president are scheduled to meet at 23:35 Paris time on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.

stories.title: Les grandes chaînes américaines solidaires de CNN, écartée de la Maison-Blanche

en.title: Major American television networks show solidarity with CNN, excluded from the White House
en.summary: CBS, ABC, NBC, and Fox have ended their participation in the presidential pool arrangement in response to CNN's exclusion from White House access.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron doit rencontrer Donald Trump en marge de l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU

en.title: Emmanuel Macron to meet Donald Trump during UN General Assembly
en.summary: The French president and U.S. president will meet Monday afternoon in New York while both are attending the UN General Assembly this week.

stories.title: Exclusion de médias de la Maison Blanche : quatre chaînes dont Fox cessent de suivre Trump, CNN attaque en justice

en.title: White House media exclusion: four networks including Fox stop covering Trump, CNN sues
en.summary: Three media outlets excluded from the Oval Office announced legal action against the U.S. government on Monday, while four other networks said they would cease coverage of the President in solidarity.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron souhaite «débattre en toute franchise» avec Donald Trump pour l’«orienter vers les bonnes décisions»

en.title: Emmanuel Macron wishes to "debate frankly" with Donald Trump to "guide him toward the right decisions"
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is set to meet Donald Trump in New York on Monday to discuss maintaining support for Ukraine and keeping pressure on Russia.

stories.title: A Paris, une nouvelle cycliste meurt après une collision avec un camion

en.title: In Paris, another cyclist dies after collision with truck
en.summary: A 57-year-old woman was killed in a cycling accident Monday morning at a bridge crossing the Seine. A cycling advocacy group highlighted the location as particularly dangerous.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Volodymyr Zelensky devrait rencontrer Donald Trump mardi à New York

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Volodymyr Zelensky to meet Donald Trump on Tuesday in New York
en.summary: The Ukrainian president is scheduled to meet his American counterpart Tuesday afternoon in New York during the United Nations General Assembly.

stories.title: Par solidarité avec CNN, les grandes chaînes américaines cessent de suivre Donald Trump

en.title: In solidarity with CNN, major American networks stop covering Donald Trump
en.summary: American media outlets CNN, MSNBC, and Politico filed legal action after being removed from the White House by Donald Trump, prompting major television networks CBS, ABC, NBC, and Fox to show unprecedented solidarity.

en.title: Rise in fuel prices: do you want reinforced assistance for motorists?
en.summary: A question regarding whether strengthened government support for motorists should be implemented in response to rising fuel costs.

en.summary: The American president will receive the French president on Monday at 11:35 PM Paris time, according to the White House schedule released Sunday evening.

stories.title: Quelles sont les pistes d'aides étudiées par le gouvernement lundi face à la flambée des prix des carburants ?

en.title: What assistance measures is the government studying Monday in response to soaring fuel prices?
en.summary: The French government is developing a stronger response to the energy crisis as fuel prices reach record levels, with several decisions pending from a Monday meeting.

stories.title: Stellantis pourrait investir un milliard d'euros pour produire un nouvel utilitaire à Hordain

en.title: Stellantis could invest one billion euros to produce a new commercial vehicle at Hordain
en.summary: Stellantis plans to invest one billion euros to manufacture a new commercial vehicle at its Hordain facility in northern France as part of restructuring efforts led by CEO Antonio Filosa.

stories.title: Emploi des seniors : Les Increvables, « une passerelle humaine entre un recruteur et un candidat »

en.title: Senior employment: Les Increvables, "a human bridge between recruiter and candidate"
en.summary: Les Increvables, an initiative in Occitanie, works to improve employment prospects for older workers by addressing persistent barriers and misconceptions that hinder their job opportunities.

stories.title: Électricité : les centrales au gaz ont davantage tourné cet été pour la climatisation

en.title: Electricity: gas plants ran more intensively this summer due to air conditioning
en.summary: Summer electricity consumption rose 4 to 5 percent, driven mainly by air conditioning demand, prompting increased output from fossil fuel plants at 4.1 TWh while drought pushed hydroelectric production to its second-lowest level in fifty years.

stories.title: Primes de bienvenue : comment BoursoBank étale le coût de sa conquête

en.title: Welcome bonuses: how BoursoBank spreads the cost of its customer acquisition
en.summary: To gain approximately five million additional customers by 2029, BoursoBank will continue funding recruitment and loyalty bonuses, with Société Générale adjusting their accounting treatment by capitalizing and amortizing them over seven years.

stories.title: Spatial : U-Space nomme un nouveau dirigeant pour l'envol commercial du fabricant de microsatellites

en.title: Space: U-Space names new leader for commercial growth of microsatellite manufacturer
en.summary: U-Space, a Toulouse-based microsatellite manufacturer, is restructuring its leadership two years after opening its first French factory to boost commercial orders and international presence.
